definitions.gloss: tobusuma; sliding door faced with fusuma on one side and wood on the other
definitions.explanation: A sliding door used where a Japanese-style room meets a Western-style room or hallway. One face is finished as a {襖|ふすま} to match the tatami room, while the other is a wooden door to match the adjoining space.

examples.japanese: {戸襖|とぶすま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧。
⟦{和室|わしつ}→和室：10437_washitsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{廊下|ろうか}→廊下：05005_rouka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{戸襖|とぶすま}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仕切|しき}られている→仕切る：04666_shikiru⟧。
examples.english: The tatami room and the hallway are partitioned by a tobusuma.

examples.japanese: {戸襖|とぶすま}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{片面|かためん}→片面：17101_katamen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{襖|ふすま}→襖：03908_fusuma⟧、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{片面|かためん}→片面：17101_katamen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{板戸|いたど}になっている。
examples.english: A tobusuma has fusuma on one side and a wooden door on the other.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{戸|と}→戸：00676_to⟧ (door) + ⟦{襖|ふすま}→襖：03908_fusuma⟧ (fusuma), with ⟦{襖|ふすま}→襖：03908_fusuma⟧ read ぶすま through rendaku.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{襖|ふすま}→襖：03908_fusuma⟧: a sliding partition papered on both sides, used between Japanese-style rooms
- ⟦{障子|しょうじ}→障子：04201_shouji⟧: a sliding door of translucent paper over a wooden lattice
- {板戸|いたど}: a solid wooden sliding door
